chapters.headline: The board as of Tuesday morning
points: Spoken edition of the Signals board; data as of 4:21 AM ET, Tuesday, October 20, 2026
37 items across five lanes; the newest items are dated Monday, October 19
One lane — AI, standards & research — has been quiet since October 8
chapters.takeaway: Everything in this briefing traces to the snapshot on the page below it: headlines, sources, and dates only.

chapters.headline: The busiest lane this week
points: Five items dated October 19, including Automation Alley on digital leadership and Manufacturing Dive on Cleveland-Cliffs and MIT's TechAMP
Manufacturing technology orders hit their 3rd-highest monthly total (AMT, via Manufacturing Dive, October 16)
Alcoa plans to sell part of its Massena East site for $315 million
chapters.takeaway: The lane is active at both ends — strategy talk at the top, and order books and asset sales underneath.

chapters.headline: Steady totals, moving filings
points: Michigan manufacturing employment: 586,700 in August 2026, up 1,100 on the month (BLS)
Unemployment 5.0% (up 0.1 points); labor force 4.85 million
WARN filings: Kern J.G. Enterprise, Sterling Heights, 156 jobs (effective Aug 17); Lear closure, Sterling Heights, 67 jobs (Nov 9); HealthEdge, Detroit, 53 jobs (Dec 1)
chapters.takeaway: The state's totals are steady; the WARN filings are where the movement is.

chapters.headline: Eight advisories, all from CISA
points: 8 CISA advisories on the board; the newest are dated October 15
October 15: Malcolm, Eclipse Milo, EseeCloud; October 13: Ignition, Swann
October 8: Red Lion N-Tron 700 series, openPDC and openHistorian, Satel Netco Design
chapters.takeaway: A steady drumbeat of advisories — the lane rewards checking your own equipment list against it.

chapters.headline: The quiet lane
points: Quiet lane: the newest item is dated October 8 — NIST joins a White House science effort
September 18: NIST awards more than $1.7 million for cybersecurity workforce development across 8 states
September 17: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies
chapters.takeaway: No new standards or research items since October 8 — the lane to watch for a change of pace.

chapters.headline: Energy takes the large funding
points: DOE advances the Constitution Pipeline with $42 million in Defense Production Act funding (October 19)
A DOE transmission project in Virginia and West Virginia also receives Defense Production Act funding (October 16)
Awards: VA to Hanger Prosthetics, $55,414; GSA to FCA US, $61,630; VA to Electra-Med, $21,507
chapters.takeaway: Energy infrastructure takes the large funding; the award notices are small and specific.

chapters.headline: Dates ahead on the board
points: Lear's Sterling Heights closure takes effect November 9; HealthEdge's Detroit layoff, December 1
The AI, standards & research lane has been quiet since October 8
Manufacturing technology orders just posted their 3rd-highest monthly total (AMT)
chapters.takeaway: The board is the record — this briefing only reads it back.
